content:
Sales records create justified conversion capacity but no cash. Import receipts identify the created quotas; conversion quotes refer to quota IDs and allocated amounts.

Existing refunds may affect older quotas independently. Manual import and platform authorization are product-specific acquisition methods: a marketplace or entity region may require one rather than the other.

CORE sales import is the manual submission path; the separate Collection Profile articles state which profiles use manual records, authorization or no conversion capacity. Do not apply an EXPORT policy to funds from an IMPORT source.
